en: Color-printed historic postcard showing a large, ornate multi-story building in a wooded setting. The structure has steep red roofs, decorative half‑timbering, and multiple small towers, resembling a grand hotel or restaurant. In front, a couple with a child and dog walk along a wide pathway; to the right is an outdoor café terrace with tables and chairs under trees. A horse-drawn carriage stands beside the building. The sky is a gradient blue, and the image has a hand‑tinted lithographic style. The words "Karlsbad." appear at the top left and "Etablissement Jägerhaus." at the top right. Additional small signs near the entrance advertise the Jägerhaus and a café.
